model.name: Reframe relevance encoder v1
model.architecture: char n-gram hashing → Linear(2048,128) → tanh → Linear(128,64) → L2

data.source: Self-authored fictional Japanese operational changes. No private or customer data.
data.splitDescription: All splits cover the same 16 topics, but each has 16 separately authored scenario families with different queries and documents. Paraphrases stay together.
data.splitDescriptionJa: 同じ16テーマの中で、各分割に別の16シナリオと文書を作成。言い換えはシナリオ単位で固定。実務データや未知テーマの評価ではありません。

measurement.timing: CPU, warm session, per-query feature extraction + all candidate encoding + scoring; excludes network/model download; not browser latency

limitations: Self-authored synthetic data, one author and a shared topic taxonomy; not independently annotated real-world evidence.
Held-out scenario families and separately authored templates reduce direct leakage but do not establish out-of-domain generalization.
A small encoder trained from scratch; no pretrained language knowledge. Random projection baseline is untrained, not a semantic embedding service.
All evaluation queries have relevant candidates. No calibrated no-answer or automatic applicability claim is made.
Relevance is distinct from validity, revision applicability, cause, safety, or approval. Those require explicit rules and human review.
Scores are relative cosine similarities, not probabilities. CPU benchmark times are not browser end-to-end times.
